```python
import random
import bisect
import statistics
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt


def task_func(n, value):
    """
    Generate n random numbers in [0, 1), return:
      - list of numbers greater than the average of all generated numbers
      - count of numbers greater than or equal to value

    Also plots the sorted generated numbers.
    """
    if not isinstance(n, int):
        raise TypeError("n must be an integer")
    if n < 0:
        raise ValueError("n must be non-negative")

    numbers = [random.random() for _ in range(n)]

    if n == 0:
        greater_than_average = []
        count_ge_value = 0

        plt.figure()
        plt.plot([], [], marker="o")
        plt.title("Sorted random numbers")
        plt.xlabel("Index")
        plt.ylabel("Value")
        plt.grid(True)
        plt.show()

        return greater_than_average, count_ge_value

    avg = statistics.mean(numbers)
    greater_than_average = [x for x in numbers if x > avg]

    sorted_numbers = sorted(numbers)
    idx = bisect.bisect_left(sorted_numbers, value)
    count_ge_value = n - idx

    plt.figure()
    plt.plot(sorted_numbers, marker="o", linestyle="-")
    plt.title("Sorted random numbers")
    plt.xlabel("Index")
    plt.ylabel("Value")
    plt.grid(True)
    plt.show()

    return greater_than_average, count_ge_value
```
